fluid_domain.evidence: Fluid network envelope: from the nitrogen triple point (63.151 K, the lowest minimum of any component) to the 900 K of the caloric fits; 100 Pa..10 MPa since P3 WP7 (design section 8.1): nitrogen and methane are declared to 10 MPa, the crude components, ethane and the light ends keep their own 2 MPa. A state past the range of a component it carries is carried, its properties continued and the island's status line noting it (owner rule of 2026-10-16); free water below its melting line freezes as ice Ih (WP4). Every phase at its own pressure (P3 WP4). The crude components keep 293.15 K and water its 273.16 K triple point inside it.
